caseNameFull: Garlotte v. Fordice, Governor of Mississippi

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, March 1, 1995. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, March 29, 1995. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
